lines.trans: Chef, forgive me, please!
I have never seen truffles before.
How could you throw away such a treasure?
In Voronezh, truffles are only candies!
Candies? This is the most expensive mushroom!
I thought that they had spoiled.
Good thing the homeless man returned them to us.

words.gloss: to give back, to get back

lines.trans: Alright, I am very kind today.
We successfully passed the difficult inspection.

words.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

lines.trans: But you will pay the bill for his dinner.
Twenty-two thousand roubles?!
This is how you will remember this lesson!

in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер
to a loved one, and at the start of letters

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
